title: Why Anthony Becht is coaching Storm, not Battlehawks, for 2026 UFL season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why Anthony Becht is coaching Storm, not Battlehawks, for 2026 UFL season
sources.description: After three successful years with the St. Louis Battlehawks, Anthony Becht has moved onto the Orlando Storm. Here's why the UFL coach switched teams.
